summary: Complete frontend testing of new Product Families overview page at /product-families. All 9 features tested and verified working correctly.

features_tested.feature: Product Families page at /product-families loads correctly
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='product-families-page', proper SEO component

features_tested.feature: Page has hero section with 'Product Families' title
features_tested.details: Hero section displays 'Product Families' h1 title with gradient text styling, subtitle 'Five distinct product lines, each crafted for specific applications'

features_tested.feature: All 5 product family quick filter buttons are displayed with correct colors
features_tested.details: Quick filter buttons found for: LumiMorph (cyan), NaturaTex (emerald), SignaTouch (amber), GlassMorph (violet), PixelVue (rose)

features_tested.feature: All 5 product family cards with icon, image, tagline, name, description, highlights, products list, explore CTA
features_tested.details: All 5 cards verified with data-testid='family-card-{id}': lumimorph, naturatex, signatouch, glassmorph, pixelvue. Each has image, icon, tagline, name, description, highlights badges, products list, and 'Explore {name}' CTA

features_tested.feature: Quick Comparison table shows all 5 families with specs
features_tested.details: Comparison table headers: Specification, LumiMorph, NaturaTex, SignaTouch, GlassMorph, PixelVue. Rows: Best For, Pixel Pitch, Key Feature, Installation, Explore (View links)

features_tested.feature: Selection Guide section shows 4 use case cards with relevant product links
features_tested.details: 4 use case cards found: 'For Luxury Interiors' (LumiMorph, NaturaTex), 'For Retail & Customer Service' (SignaTouch, PixelVue), 'For Glass & Architecture' (GlassMorph), 'For Creative Installations' (PixelVue Creative, Flying Display)

features_tested.feature: CTA section with 'Talk to an Expert' and 'Technology Quiz' buttons
features_tested.details: 'Talk to an Expert' links to /contact, 'Technology Quiz' links to /technology-selector. Both buttons properly styled

features_tested.feature: Each product family card links to the correct landing page
features_tested.details: Verified all links: lumimorph→/lumimorph, naturatex→/naturatex, signatouch→/signatouch, glassmorph→/glassmorph, pixelvue→/pixelvue

features_tested.feature: Product Families link is accessible from Products dropdown in navigation
features_tested.details: 'Product Families' link found in Products dropdown with data-testid='nav-products-families', links to /product-families. Link has gradient text styling

critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: React key issue with 'outdoor' appearing in Navbar productCategories - duplicates present in OUTDOOR DISPLAYS section
Minor HTML hydration warnings in table structure due to React framework internals (not affecting user experience)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product Families page at /product-families displays all 5 product families: LumiMorph (cyan), NaturaTex (emerald), SignaTouch (amber), GlassMorph (violet), PixelVue (rose). Each card links to its respective landing page. Page includes Quick Comparison table, Selection Guide with 4 use cases, and CTA section. Product Families link is accessible from Products dropdown in navbar with data-testid='nav-products-families'.
